expectations.text: Report examines both en and ru message files
expectations.evidence: Both EN and RU analyzed extensively with specific examples from each

expectations.text: Report checks that keys are consistent between en and ru files
expectations.evidence: Explicitly reports 551 key parity, checks placeholder consistency, analyzes duplicate values across locales

expectations.text: Review depth is appropriate for i18n files
expectations.evidence: 161-line report is proportional, includes structural observations section that adds value without bloat

expectations.text: Report has a clear verdict or summary
expectations.evidence: Clear 'Mostly good' verdict with prioritized recommendations list
